notes.title: RIDE - Patch #2
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i58.tinypic.com/4vphms.jpg[/IMG]

Dear Gamers,

We apologize for the issues you were facing in the last weeks, we’re now happy to inform you that we’ve just released a patch to solve them.

[b]You can find below the changelog:[/b]

- Vast number of fixes on 3D Bikes: custom parts, textures, materials.
- Physics tweaking on three bikes: Honda RC30, Honda RC45 and Yamaha FZR750 OW01.
- Added the option to replay intro movies of bike categories.
- Online starting grid menu no more remains during race.
- Visual and physics tweaking for many DLC bikes.
- Online stability improvements.
- Various minor fixes.

Please help us to improve your game experience by reporting issues on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/345660/discussions/0/618457398964899602/ ]Bug Thread[/url]

Continue to follow us on: 

- [url=https://www.facebook.com/RideGame] Facebook [/url] 
- [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/RideVideogame] Official Youtube Channel [/url]
- [url=https://twitter.com/milestoneitaly] Twitter [/url] [b] hashtag #ridevideogame [/b]
- [url=http://ridevideogame.com/] Official Website [/url]

Milestone Team

notes.title: RIDE - Patch
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-mxp.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xap1/v/t1.0-9/10354658_1593466740923071_2397150126791769392_n.jpg?oh=f9427677f48eadf4183e0ea8878dba37&oe=55BD24A9[/img]

Dear Gamers,

 we apologize for the issue you were facing in this days, we're happy to inform you that we've yet release a patch to solve the crashes and savegame corruption.

[u]If the savegames were corrupted you have to delete them and restart the game[/u]

We hope you'll enjoy to RIDE back on the World Tour!

 Please help us to improve your game experience by reporting issues on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/345660/discussions/0/618457398964899602/ ]Bug Thread[/url]

Thank you for your understanding.

Milestone Team
